description: This Java class 'DefaultMetricsReporterConfig' provides the default implementation of a configuration object for metrics reporting, focusing on resolution duration and history size. It includes methods for creating instances from a configuration object, as well as standard overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultMetricsReporterConfig
classes.description: Final class implementing MetricsReporterConfig, representing configuration for metrics reporting with resolution and history parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultMetricsReporterConfig from a given Config object, using a fallback mechanism based on a specified configuration path.

methods.name: getResolution
methods.description: Returns the resolution Duration for metrics reporting.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns the history size (integer) for metrics reporting.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on resolution and history.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on resolution and history.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this configuration instance.
